results.id: OS1 valid session: reopens offline, shows saved data, banner shown, entry saved locally
OS1b second offline cold start: entry still there, still no cloud writes
OS2 reconnect: account confirmed, then the person is asked which copy to keep; nothing sent or replaced meanwhile
OS2c keep this device: entry reaches the cloud exactly once, nothing else changes, banner gone
OS2b after reload online: still exactly one copy locally and in the cloud
OS3 expired token: still reopens offline within the startup limit, saved data usable, entry saved locally, banner shown
OS4 expired token, reconnect: server refreshes the session, person asked, nothing sent before choosing, entry then synced exactly once
OS5 first-time device offline: not let in (welcome / sign-in shown, no app, no banner)
OS6 signed in, no saved data, offline: not offered the offline resume (no banner)
OS6 signed in, setup not finished, offline: not offered the offline resume (no banner)
OS7 session revoked meanwhile: reconnect sends the person to sign-in; saved data kept; nothing uploaded
OS8 online start: no offline banner, entry syncs exactly once
OS9 both devices changed: the person is asked; the other device's record and this device's entry both still exist; nothing sent
OS9b choosing the cloud copy first backs up this device's version (the offline entry is recoverable)
OS10 data service drops mid-check: stays usable in offline mode (no 'Can't reach' wall), nothing sent
OS10b 'Try again' after it recovers: the person is asked which copy to keep
OS11 online sign-in on a new device: reaches the app with the account's data, no offline banner
OS11b signed out: Welcome shown, data kept on the device, and reopening offline does NOT resume (no saved session)
SAFE no request ever went to a supabase host
